fixedRules: Pre-release layouts disposable. Client retry identities required typed route/command values.
Native business facts authoritative; technical process state is not policy authority.
Preserve current personal-HTTP policy and accepted business rules; do not silently add an external sending integration.
A projection or second read cannot make cross-owner writes atomic.

bulk_admission.evidence: Current RecordBulkAccessDecision uses one campaign revision/preview for an all-item decision. Target public command writes a newly created AccessReviewDecisionBatch but still has ExpectedRevision; that field formerly meant campaign revision. Completion must account for an admitted but unpublished batch.

alternatives.campaign_admit_then_batch: Public command first appends complete bulk admission to AccessReviewCampaign under ExpectedCampaignRevision; child batch keyed DecisionBatchId owns reservations/provisional effects/publication. Campaign close drains pre-seal batch admissions before item proof holds.
alternatives.batch_first_with_owner_revision: Keep writing a new batch, compare ExpectedRevision to new batch zero, let the original campaign preview be advisory.
alternatives.campaign_all_item_state: Keep all bulk/per-item histories in the parent campaign forever.

alternatives.program_admit_then_compute: RunReadinessAssessment writes ProgramReadiness with ExpectedProgramRevision, required AssessmentId, fixed asOf/input cut and rules. One pending latest adoption at a time; compute child assessment from frozen inputs, then adopt with exact admitted generation. Decision cannot sign old latest while newer admitted run is pending.
alternatives.assessment_first_success: Write a new assessment and report success, then independently attempt latest adoption using an expected program revision absent from the public request.
alternatives.retain_all_history: Keep all complete assessments/plans/decisions in the old ReadinessLedger.

alternatives.gap_admit_then_link: Link command first appends immutable link admission to ProviderAssuranceGap under ExpectedGapRevision and open/current rule; child link materializes even if gap later closes because admission already serialized. Bind acceptance validity at admission and never close gap by risk link.
alternatives.child_live_check: New link owner reads gap open and appends independently using former gap revision as new-link revision.
alternatives.merge_report_all: Keep all provider reports/reviews/gaps/links in one tenant register.

alternatives.personal_recording_only: Preserve personal HTTP command recording exact external handoff, recipient, authored DeliveredAt and reference; serialize manifest/archive/current-validation/recipient-approval gate before independently materializing delivery fact. Remove automatic-send worker and unused new authorization API until an explicit transport/product contract is supplied.
alternatives.invent_auto_send: Replace personal actor with system callback and introduce an automated send without channel, transport or provider receipt contract.
alternatives.remove_delivery_guards: Keep personal recording but discard manifest validation to simplify splitting.

fact_payload_contract.evidence: ApplicationImportPlanSealed currently has BatchId, Revision and PlanSha256 only after the row-freeze events were classified as technical. BuildRequested now has ChangeRef whose declared schema only names the request (no captured BuildId/manifest version/archive selection).

alternatives.typed_durable_intents: Define exact named immutable intent/result records with server-resolved source values, manifests, IDs, source cuts and deadlines. Native seal/reference events point to those schemas; do not reconstruct from mutable aggregates or removed row-freeze facts.
alternatives.command_only_refs: Treat serialized request fields plus hash as enough to reconstruct all accepted server-resolved work later.
alternatives.keep_all_row_stage_events: Retain staging/cursor events forever as business authority.

decision_source_use.evidence: Service acceptance reserves service epoch and permanent staff/user practice keys but current partner designation, directory active status and ratified-rule source can change between proof read and irreversible authorization.

alternatives.explicit_source_use: Acquire exact source-version use permits for directory, partner duty and rule/ratification authority before the irreversible engagement authorization, held to the specified commit point. Revocation/version publication checks the same source guard; after release authoritative current-eligibility reads immediately invalidate stale acceptance.
alternatives.read_twice: Read those mutable sources twice before appending to a separate engagement owner.
alternatives.freeze_forever: Prevent directory/status/rule changes permanently after any engagement acceptance.
